title: About the race — official page (elevation, terrain, loops, wildlife species, contacts)
publisher: Lewa Safari Marathon (official event site, Tusk and Lewa Wildlife Conservancy)
claims: The race sits about 5,500 ft above sea level on rocky trails across savannah plains, river banks and acacia woodland.
The half marathon is one loop of the conservancy; the full marathon is two loops; the half is described as 13 miles and the full as 26 miles.
The conservancy hosts the Big Five, more than 70 animal species and over 400 bird species; Lewa holds about 12% of Kenya's black and white rhinos and the world's largest Grevy's zebra population.
Contact addresses: overseas corporate adele@tusk.org, overseas individuals hannah@tusk.org, Kenyan runners marathon@lewa.org, Kenyan corporate winfred@tusk.org.
